title: What are loss-decomp's final figures?
body:
## What exists today

loss-decomp draws three figures: `loss-decomp-hits.pdf` from `plot.py`, a letter page of eight panels off `stages.tbl` and `cutoff-pairs.tbl`, and `loss-decomp-depth-binned.pdf` and `loss-decomp-depth-cumulative.pdf` from `plot_depth.py`, off `depth.tbl`. The ones in `figures/` were drawn on the 12 October cutoffs. A sandbox run on the 15 October cutoffs is in `tmp-claude/sandbox/figures-newcut/`.

## Open

Which figures loss-decomp contributes to the paper, and what each one shows.
